title: A New English Teacher
passage: It is Monday morning, and the students are back at school. Ms Li is their new English teacher. She says, "Good morning, class!" The students say, "Good morning, Ms Li!" Ms Li asks Amy, "What's your name?" Amy says, "My name is Amy." Then Ms Li asks Daming. Daming says, "I'm Daming. Nice to meet you!" Ms Li smiles. She says, "Welcome to our school! Now stand up, please. Open your books." The students stand up and open their books. They are very happy on the first day of school.
passageZh: 这是星期一的早上，学生们回到学校。李老师是他们的新英语老师。她说："早上好，同学们！"学生们说："早上好，李老师！"李老师问艾米："你叫什么名字？"艾米说："我的名字叫艾米。"然后李老师问大明。大明说："我是大明。很高兴见到您！"李老师笑了。她说："欢迎来到我们学校！现在请起立，打开你们的书。"学生们起立并打开书。开学的第一天他们非常开心。

title: Boboo the Bird
passage: Boboo is a small bird. It is the first day of school. Boboo flies to the classroom. It sees Lingling. Boboo says, "Hello! What's your name?" Lingling says, "My name is Lingling. Nice to meet you!" Boboo says, "Nice to meet you too! Let's play together after school." Lingling says, "Great! Goodbye, Boboo! Have a nice day!" Boboo flies up and smiles. It likes the new school and its new friend Lingling.

title: In the Classroom
passage: It is a nice morning. The students are in the classroom. Their teacher says, "Hello, everyone! Stand up, please." The students stand up. Then the teacher says, "Open your books." The students open their books. A little boy cannot find his book. His friend helps him. The teacher says, "Good work! Now close your books. Goodbye, class!" The students say, "Goodbye, teacher! Have a nice day!"

title: Greetings at School
passage: When you meet your teacher at school in the morning, you can say "Good morning!". When you meet a new friend, you can say "Hello! What's your name?". The new friend says, "My name is Tom. Nice to meet you!". You can say, "Nice to meet you too!". When school is over, you can say "Goodbye! Have a nice day!". In class, the teacher says "Stand up!" and "Open your books!". You listen carefully. English greetings are easy and fun!

title: Welcome to Our School

The teacher opens the door and says, "Stand up, please. Open your books. Let's begin!"

title: Sam and Amy

title: Colourful Balloons

title: Snack Time
passage: It is snack time at school. Tom takes out a red apple. He likes apples very much. Amy takes out a banana. She doesn't like apples. She likes bananas. Daming takes out an orange. He likes oranges. He doesn't like pears. Lingling takes out some bread. She likes bread and milk. Ms Li says, "Do you like snacks? Share them, please!" The children share their food. They are very happy. Each child says what food they like and what they don't like. They pass the food around and taste a little of each. Eating together makes the food taste even better. The classroom becomes warm and friendly.

title: Do You Like Milk?
passage: Lily likes milk. She drinks a glass of milk every morning. Her brother Tom doesn't like milk. He likes juice. Their dad likes coffee. Their mum likes tea. One day, Lily asks Tom, "Do you like milk?" Tom says, "No, I don't. I like orange juice. What about you?" Lily says, "I like milk. It makes me strong." Tom says, "OK. I will try milk too." Mum smiles, "Good idea!"

title: Fruit I Like
passage: There are many fruits. Apples are red and sweet. Bananas are yellow and long. Oranges are orange and juicy. Pears are green and sweet. Grapes are purple. I like apples and oranges. I don't like bananas. My friend Sam likes bananas. He doesn't like grapes. My sister Amy likes pears. She eats a pear every day. Fruit grows on trees and vines in many places. It gives us vitamins and makes our body healthy. We can eat fruit between meals instead of sweets. What a colourful and tasty world of fruit!

title: My Lunch
passage: Today I have lunch at school. I have rice, chicken and vegetables. I also have an apple. I like rice and chicken. I don't like carrots. My friend Tom has noodles and an egg. He likes noodles. He doesn't like rice. Amy has bread and milk. She doesn't like noodles. After lunch, we have some fruit. I have an orange. Tom has a banana. What a nice lunch! We talk about our food while we eat. Some food is healthy and some is just a little sweet. We finish our lunch and clear the plates. A good lunch gives us energy for the afternoon.

title: Do You Like Snacks?
passage: Snacks are nice, but we should not eat too many. Cakes and candies are sweet. They are not good for our teeth. Fruit and milk are healthy. We can eat apples, bananas and oranges every day. title: Our Hobbies
passage: The children are talking about their hobbies. Lingling likes singing. She sings English songs every day. Daming likes drawing. He draws tigers and pandas. Amy likes dancing. title: I Like Drawing
passage: Daming likes drawing very much. He draws every day. He draws animals: tigers, pandas, monkeys and elephants. He also draws trees and flowers. One day, he draws a big tiger. The tiger is yellow and black. He shows it to Amy. Amy says, "Wow! You draw very well! Is it a dog?" Daming laughs, "No! It's a tiger. Look! It has a long tail." Amy says, "Great! I like drawing too. Can you teach me?" Daming says, "Sure!" He keeps a small notebook and draws every picture carefully. He likes watching animals near the park before he draws them. Drawing helps him see the world in a new way. Amy is happy to learn from a good friend.

title: Running in the Park
passage: Sam likes running. Every morning, he runs in the park. He runs with his dad. They run for twenty minutes. Sam can run very fast. His friend Amy likes running too. They run together after school. Today, they have a running race. Sam runs fast. Amy runs fast too. At last, Sam is first and Amy is second. They are both happy. Sam says, "Running is my hobby. It makes me strong." Running in the open air makes their hearts strong. They stretch their legs before the race and drink water after it. They do not care who wins the most. What matters is that they enjoy the sport together.

title: Taking Photos
passage: Tom likes taking photos. He has a small camera. On weekends, he goes to the park with his camera. He takes photos of birds, flowers and trees. He takes a photo of a red bird on a branch. He takes a photo of yellow flowers. He shows his photos to his friends. They say, "Wow! They are beautiful!" Tom says, "I like taking photos. Every photo tells a story." His friend Lily says, "Can you take a photo of me?" Tom says, "Sure! Smile! Click!" He cleans his little camera after every outing. He waits quietly for a good moment before he clicks. His friends all want to be in his pictures. Taking photos helps him remember happy days.

title: Tai Chi Fun
passage: Today after school, the children go to the park. Grandpa is doing tai chi. The children watch. Grandpa says, "Do you like doing tai chi? Come and try!" Lingling says, "I like doing tai chi!" Daming says, "Me too!" They move their arms slowly. They turn left and right. It is not fast, but it is relaxing. Grandpa smiles, "Good work! Tai chi makes you healthy and strong." The children say, "We like doing tai chi! Let's come every weekend!" Tai chi moves are slow and smooth, like water. Grandpa says it helps both body and mind stay calm. The children breathe slowly and follow every movement. They feel relaxed and want to practise again.
passageZh: 今天放学后，孩子们去公园。爷爷在打太极。孩子们看着。爷爷说："你们喜欢打太极吗？来试试！"玲玲说："我喜欢打太极！"大明说："我也是！"他们慢慢地摆胳膊。他们向左转、向右转。它不快，但很放松。爷爷笑了："干得好！太极让你们健康强壮。"孩子们说："我们喜欢打太极！我们每个周末都来！" 太极的动作缓慢又流畅，像水一样。爷爷说它能让身心都保持平静。孩子们缓慢呼吸，跟着每个动作。他们感到放松，还想再练。

title: Tom's Busy Day
passage: Tom has a busy day. At six o'clock, he gets up. He washes his face. At seven o'clock, he goes to school. He has four classes in the morning. At twelve o'clock, he has lunch at school. At four o'clock, school is over. He plays with his friends for a while. At five o'clock, he goes home and has some milk and cake. Then he does his homework. At nine o'clock, he goes to bed. What a busy but happy day! Tom knows each time well and never rushes. He looks at the clock before he starts each activity. Having a clear timetable helps him finish everything. A good routine makes a day feel easy and happy.
passageZh: 汤姆忙碌的一天。六点钟，他起床。他洗脸。七点钟，他去上学。他上午有四节课。十二点钟，他在学校吃午饭。四点钟，放学了。他和朋友玩了一会儿。五点钟，他回家，喝些牛奶、吃块蛋糕，然后做作业。九点钟，他上床睡觉。多么忙碌又快乐的一天！汤姆清楚每个时间点，从不慌张。开始每项活动前他都看钟。清晰的时间表帮他完成所有事。良好的日常安排让一天轻松又快乐。

title: It's Time for School
passage: It is seven o'clock. Mum says, "Tom! It's seven o'clock. It's time for school. Get up!" Tom opens his eyes. "Oh! I'm late!" He runs to the bathroom. He washes his face. He puts on his school uniform. He takes his schoolbag. Mum gives him an egg and milk. "Hurry up!" she says. Tom runs to the bus stop. The bus is coming. Tom waves, "Goodbye, Mum!" What a rushed morning! The clock on the wall tells them it is late. Eating breakfast quickly and catching the bus is a morning rush. Tom will get up a little earlier next time. Good morning habits make the day start smoothly.

title: Time to Go to Bed
passage: It is nine o'clock at night. Mum says, "Tom! It's nine o'clock. It's time to go to bed." Tom says, "But Mum, I want to read my book." Mum says, "No, it's late. You can read tomorrow." Tom puts on his pyjamas. He brushes his teeth. He goes to bed. Mum kisses him good night. "Good night, Mum." says Tom. "Sweet dreams," says Mum. Tom closes his eyes. It is time to sleep. At night, the room becomes quiet and dark. A good night's sleep helps children grow and learn. Mum checks the window and the door before she leaves. Tom falls asleep quickly and dreams happily.

title: Clock Time
passage: A clock has two hands. The short hand tells the hour. The long hand tells the minutes. At six o'clock, the long hand points to twelve. The short hand points to six. At seven o'clock, the short hand points to seven. At twelve o'clock, both hands point to twelve. Clocks help us know the time. We know when to get up, when to go to school, when to have lunch and when to go to bed. Time is important. Let's make good use of time! A clock can hang on the wall or sit on the desk. Some clocks are round and some are square. We also tell time on our watches and phones. Knowing the time helps us plan every part of the day.

passage: We go to school from Monday to Friday. On Monday, we have Chinese. On Tuesday, we have maths. On Wednesday, we have English. On Thursday, we have art. On Friday, we have PE. passage: Last week, our school had a sports meeting. There were many events like running, high jump and long jump. I took part in the running race. I ran as fast as I could. After the race, our teacher gave each child a small sticker. We felt a little tired but very happy.

title: My Favourite Animal — The Rabbit
passage: My favourite animal is the rabbit. Rabbits are very cute. They have long ears and short tails. They like eating carrots. Rabbits can jump very fast. They live in holes. I often see rabbits in the zoo. I like watching them play. A rabbit can run a little, but it is best at jumping. It can hop across the grass quickly. Many children love rabbits because they are soft and quiet. Rabbits live in grassy fields and quietly eat fresh green vegetables. They are soft to touch, and their long ears can turn to catch every small sound. In the zoo, a keeper gives them clean water and fresh carrots every day. Watching them hop makes children laugh. They are gentle animals that do not hurt anyone.

title: My Hobby
passage: My hobby is painting. I like to draw pictures of animals, flowers and beautiful places. I use different colours to make my pictures look vivid. Every weekend, I go to the park to draw. My mother puts my favourite pictures on the fridge so everyone can see them. I keep my brushes clean after each drawing. Every picture has a small story behind it, and I hope to share more pictures with my class one day.

title: My Weekend
passage: I had a great weekend. On Saturday morning, I did my homework. In the afternoon, I went to the park with my parents. We flew a kite there. On Sunday, I visited my grandparents. I helped them clean the house. I swept the floor and tidied the table. Then we had a big dinner together. It was a wonderful weekend. Helping at home makes me feel proud, and my grandparents were very happy. In the park, we walked under big trees and sat on a bench to rest. My mother took photos of us flying the kite. On Sunday evening, Grandma made hot tea and we talked about the week. Helping at home does not take much time, but it makes the family feel warm. I plan to clean my own room every weekend from now on.
passageZh: 我度过了一个愉快的周末。星期六早上我做作业，下午和父母去公园放风筝。星期天我去看望祖父母，帮他们打扫房子，我扫地、收拾桌子，然后一起吃了丰盛的晚餐。这是个美好的周末。在家里帮忙让我感到自豪，祖父母也很开心。在公园，我们走在大树下，坐在长椅上休息。妈妈给我们放风筝拍了照。星期天晚上，奶奶泡了热茶，我们聊聊这一周。帮忙做家务花不了多少时间，却让家里很温暖。从现在起我打算每个周末都收拾自己的房间。

It's a picture of the beach. I keep my room clean. I put my clothes away and sweep the floor every weekend. I like my bedroom because it's a comfortable place. Every weekend I sweep the floor and make the bed myself. The lamp on my desk gives soft light when I read at night. I keep my pencils in a small cup so nothing rolls away. The beach picture reminds me of a happy summer holiday. A clean and personal bedroom is a quiet place to rest after a busy day at school.

passage: My classroom is on the second floor. It is big and bright. There are 30 desks and chairs for students. There is a teacher's desk at the front. title: The Weather
passage: Today is sunny. The sun is shining brightly. It's a good day to go outside. The temperature is 25 degrees Celsius. We can wear T-shirts and shorts. There are some white clouds in the blue sky. It's very beautiful. The wind is soft and warm. We can fly a kite in the park. Nobody needs a coat today. What a lovely sunny day! After breakfast, we put on light clothes and walk to the park. The soft wind carries the smell of grass and flowers. Some people sit on benches reading, and children run after their kites. The clouds move slowly across the blue sky. On a day like this, staying inside would be a pity, so everyone enjoys the fresh air outside.

title: My Trip to the Beach
passage: Last summer, I went on a trip to the beach with my family. We took a train to get there. The beach was very beautiful. The sand was soft. We built sandcastles on the beach. I swam in the sea. It was so much fun. We also ate delicious seafood. The sun was hot and the sky was clear. I hope to go there again. On the beach, we built a tall castle with a small tower and a moat. The waves came in softly and wet our feet. We sat under a big umbrella and shared cold fruit juice. The sun shone on the water, which looked like silver. We took many photos and bought a small shell as a souvenir. I still keep that shell on my desk at home.
passageZh: 去年夏天，我和家人去海滩旅行。我们坐火车去的。海滩很美，沙子很软。我们在沙滩上堆沙堡，我在海里游泳，非常开心。我们还吃了美味的海鲜。太阳很晒，天空晴朗。我希望再去一次。在海滩，我们堆了一座带小塔和护城河的高城堡。海浪轻轻涌上来，弄湿我们的脚。我们坐在大伞下，分喝冰镇果汁。阳光照在水面上，像银子一样。我们拍了很多照片，还买了一枚小贝壳作纪念，现在仍放在家里书桌上。

title: The Park
passage: There is a beautiful park near my home. In the park, there are many trees and flowers. There is a lake in the park. We can see ducks swimming on the lake. There is also a playground. Children can play on the swings and slides. People often go to the park to relax. On sunny days, the park is full of people. It's a great place to have fun. On weekends, my family often rides our bikes to this park. We bring bread to feed the ducks, but we never feed them unhealthy food. The playground has swings, a slide and a small climbing frame. Old people do tai chi on the open ground in the morning. The park brings neighbours together and makes the whole neighbourhood feel friendly.

title: My Day
passage: I get up at 7:00 in the morning. Then I have breakfast. I go to school at 7:30. I have four classes in the morning. After class, I play games with my classmates. I have lunch at school. In the afternoon, I have two classes. After school, I go home and do my homework. I watch TV for a while before going to bed. It's a busy but happy day. At noon, we share lunch with classmates in the classroom. Afternoon classes finish, and I play ball games before walking home. In the evening, I help set the table and tell my parents about my day. A good rest at night helps me start the next morning happily. Small habits like being on time make each school day smooth.

title: My Favourite Song
passage: My favourite song is "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star". It's a beautiful song. The lyrics are easy to remember. I love to sing this song before going to bed. It makes me feel relaxed. I can also listen to it on the radio. On a calm, clear night, I look at the stars and sing along. The song always makes me feel warm and quiet. My mother sings the song to me when I cannot fall asleep. The simple tune stays in my head all day. I know every word by heart and can sing it without looking. Sometimes my little brother sings along in a soft voice. A favourite song can cheer us up even on a grey, rainy day, and it becomes a warm memory we keep for years.
passageZh: 我最喜欢的歌是《小星星》。它很好听，歌词好记。我喜欢睡前唱这首歌，它让我放松。我也能在收音机里听到它。宁静晴朗的夜晚，我看着星星跟着唱。这首歌总让我感到温暖安静。我睡不着时，妈妈给我唱这首歌。简单的旋律一整天都在我脑子里。我把每个词都背熟，不用看就能唱。有时弟弟也小声跟着唱。即使在阴沉雨天，喜欢的歌也能让我们开心，它会成为珍藏多年的温暖回忆。

title: The Four Seasons
passage: There are four seasons in a year. Spring is a beautiful season. The grass turns green and the flowers come out. We can fly kites in spring. Summer is hot. We can swim in the pool. Autumn is a harvest season. The leaves on the trees turn yellow and fall down. We can pick apples. Winter is cold. Sometimes it snows. We can make a snowman. Each season is special. In spring, days grow longer and the air feels warm. Farmers work in the fields, and birds build their nests in trees. In summer, we eat cold watermelon and hide from strong sun. In autumn, farmers are busy picking fruit and storing rice. In winter, we wear thick coats and stay warm by the window. No season is boring; each one gives us a different kind of fun.
passageZh: 一年有四个季节。春天很美，草变绿、花开放，我们可以放风筝。夏天热，我们可以在泳池游泳。秋天是收获季节，树叶变黄落下，我们可以摘苹果。冬天冷，有时下雪，我们可以堆雪人。每个季节都特别。春天白天变长，空气温暖。农民在田里劳作，鸟在树上筑巢。夏天我们吃冰西瓜、躲避烈日。秋天农民忙着摘果、存粮。冬天我们穿厚外套，在窗边取暖。没有哪个季节无聊，每个季节都给我们不同的乐趣。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上阅读小纸条第2篇（The Four Seasons，补D项）

title: My Favourite Season — Autumn
passage: My favourite season is autumn. In autumn, the weather is cool. The leaves on the trees turn red and yellow. We can pick fruits in autumn. Apples and pears are delicious. I like going to the orchard with my family. We have a great time picking fruits. The sky is high and the air is fresh. Autumn is a wonderful season. In autumn, we often drive to the orchard on sunny weekends. The trees are heavy with red and yellow fruit, and the air smells fresh. My father climbs a low ladder, and we fill one big basket together. After picking, we eat a pear under the tree and rest for a while. Cool wind, good fruit and family time make autumn my favourite season of the year.

title: My Favourite Season — Spring
passage: My favourite season is spring. New grass covers the ground and little flowers open. The weather is warm. We can fly kites in the park. Birds sing in the trees. I often go on a picnic with my family in spring. We take some food and drinks and enjoy the nice day outside. Everything looks fresh and new. On spring picnics, we spread a blanket under a big tree. We bring sandwiches, fruit juice and hard-boiled eggs. Butterflies fly between the flowers, and bees visit them busily. My dog runs on the grass and chases a ball. When the wind blows, the new leaves dance in the sun. Spring makes everyone feel hopeful and ready to grow.

source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上阅读小纸条第25篇（My Favorite Season spring，补D项）

title: My Birthday Party
passage: Yesterday was my birthday. I had a big party at home. Many of my friends came to the party. We ate a big birthday cake. It was delicious. We also played games like hide-and-seek. Everyone had a great time. My parents gave me a nice gift. I was very happy. The house was full of laughter. It was a lovely day to remember. After the cake, we played musical chairs and told funny jokes. The room was decorated with balloons and coloured paper. We cleaned the room together after the party. A birthday is special because it reminds us how many people love and care about us.

source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上阅读小纸条第12篇（My Birthday Party，补D项）

title: The Zoo
passage: Last Sunday, I went to the zoo with my parents. We saw many animals there. The monkeys were very funny. They jumped and played around. The pandas were cute. They ate bamboo. The lions were strong. They walked around in their cages. We also saw giraffes with long necks. It was a great day at the zoo. We took many photos and learned a lot about animals. Before leaving, my parents told me not to feed the animals or knock on their cages. We walked slowly and kept our voices low. The giraffes ate leaves from a tall tree, and the elephants sprayed water with their trunks. We bought small animal stickers at the gate. A zoo visit teaches us to love and protect animals, and it is a day we remember happily.
passageZh: 上个星期天，我和父母去了动物园，看到很多动物。猴子很滑稽，跳来跳去玩耍。熊猫可爱，吃竹子。狮子强壮，在笼子里走来走去。我们还看到长脖子的长颈鹿。在动物园度过了很棒的一天，我们拍了很多照片，学到很多关于动物的知识。离开前，父母告诉我不要喂动物、不要敲笼子。我们慢慢走，压低声音。长颈鹿吃高树上的叶子，大象用鼻子喷水。我们在门口买了小动物贴纸。逛动物园教会我们爱护、保护动物，是值得快乐回忆的一天。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上阅读小纸条第7篇（The Zoo，补D项）

title: Going to School
passage: I usually go to school by bike. First, I ride along the street. Then I turn left at the traffic lights. The school is on the right. Sometimes I go to school by bus. I wait for the bus at the bus stop. The bus takes me to school. My school is not far from my home. It's convenient to go to school. Riding a bike is also good exercise and does not pollute the air. At the traffic lights, I stop and wait even when the street looks empty. My bike has a bell and a small basket for my bag. On rainy days, my mother drives me to school instead. Knowing different ways to travel helps us choose a safe and green route every day.

title: My Family
passage: There are four people in my family. They are my father, mother, little brother and me. My father is a driver. He drives a bus every day. My mother is a nurse. She works in a hospital. My little brother is very cute. He likes to play with his toys. I love my family very much. Every day my father takes the bus route and brings people safely home. After work, my father comes home tired but smiles. He knows every street on his route and greets regular passengers by name. My mother works quietly and checks each patient carefully. My little brother shares his toys with neighbours' children. In the evening, we sit at one table and share our day. Every family member does his or her part, and that makes our home warm.

title: My Favourite Food — Pizza
passage: My favourite food is pizza. It's delicious. Pizza has a lot of toppings, like cheese, tomatoes and meat. I like the cheese on the pizza best. It makes the pizza taste so good. I often eat pizza in the pizza restaurant with my family. We share a big pizza. Everyone enjoys it. We go there by bus on weekends. The restaurant is not far from our home. The pizza restaurant is on a quiet street near the park. The waiter brings hot pizza to our table, and the cheese stretches when we lift a slice. My father usually orders mushrooms, while I only want cheese. We drink warm cola and talk about the week. Sharing one big pizza means everyone gets a taste of each topping, and that makes the meal fun.
passageZh: 我最喜欢的食物是披萨，很好吃。披萨有很多配料，比如奶酪、番茄和肉。我最喜欢披萨上的奶酪，它让披萨特别香。我常和家人去披萨店吃，我们分一个大披萨，大家都喜欢。周末我们坐公交去，餐厅离家不远。披萨店在公园附近一条安静街上。服务员把热披萨端上桌，掀起一片时奶酪会拉丝。爸爸通常点蘑菇，而我只要奶酪。我们喝热可乐，聊聊这一周。分一个大披萨，每个人都能尝到每种配料，这让吃饭很有趣。

title: My School Day
passage: I have a busy but interesting school day. I get to school at 8:00. The first class is English. I like English because the teacher is very kind. After English, we have math. Math is a little difficult, but I try my best. At noon, I have lunch in the school cafeteria. We have different kinds of food like rice, noodles and vegetables. In the afternoon, I have PE class. We play basketball and run on the playground. School finishes at 4:30. Then I go home and do my homework. The cafeteria serves different food each day, so we never get bored. Our English teacher often joins us and asks about our weekend. In PE class, we take turns running and resting so nobody gets hurt. After homework, I read a few pages before bed. A balanced school day keeps our body active and our mind ready to learn.

title: The Library
passage: The library is a quiet place. There are many books on different subjects. We can borrow books about science, history and stories. We need to be quiet in the library. We can't talk loudly. We can read books and do our homework there. The library helps us learn a lot. We walk or take the bus to get there. It opens from morning to afternoon every weekday. The library is free for every student, and we may keep books for two weeks. Our class visits once a month, and we choose books quietly. The librarian helps us find stories about animals and science. We return books on time so others can borrow them too. A library is a quiet treasure house where every child can travel through reading.

title: The Library Rules
passage: The library is a great place to read and study. But we must follow the rules. We should keep quiet in the library so that everyone can read without noise. We can borrow two books at a time and keep them for two weeks. We need to return the books on time. We can't write or draw on the books. If we lose the books, we have to pay for them. Walk straight in and enjoy reading. Reading in the library trains our patience and quiet manners. When we find a book, we carry it with both hands and turn pages gently. We mark our name on the library card before taking a book home. If a book is damaged, we tell the librarian instead of hiding it. Following rules lets everyone enjoy reading in a clean, peaceful library for years.
passageZh: 图书馆是阅读学习的好地方，但我们必须遵守规则。要保持安静，让大家不受打扰地阅读。一次可以借两本书，借两周，需要按时归还。不能在书上写字或画画。如果弄丢书，必须赔偿。走进去，享受阅读吧。在图书馆阅读培养耐心和安静的举止。找到书后，我们双手捧着，轻轻翻页。把书带回家前，我们在借书卡上写名字。书损坏时，我们告诉管理员而不是藏起来。遵守规则，让大家多年都能在干净安宁的图书馆阅读。

title: My Favourite Animal — The Panda
passage: My favourite animal is the panda. Pandas are very cute. They are black and white. Pandas live in bamboo forests. They like to eat bamboo. Pandas are very lazy. They rest a lot and sleep for many hours. But they are very popular all over the world. When you walk into the zoo, go straight on and turn left, and you will find the panda house. Pandas spend much of the day eating bamboo and resting on soft branches. They move slowly, but they can climb trees when they want. Visitors walk along a wooden path and watch from a distance. Our government protects bamboo forests so pandas have enough food. Seeing a real panda in the zoo makes every child smile, and we hope they live safely for ever.

title: My Family's Jobs
passage: There are five people in my family. My father is a doctor. He works in a big hospital. He helps sick people get better. My mother is a nurse. She works in the same hospital and takes care of patients. My uncle is a driver. He drives a bus from morning to night. My aunt is a teacher. She works at a primary school and loves her students. Every job is important, and we respect all workers. At the dinner table, we often talk about our day at work or school. My father tells us how he helps patients, and my mother describes the patients she cares for. My uncle drives carefully even when the road is busy. Each job uses different skills, but all of them serve people. When we grow up, we may choose different jobs, yet we should always respect everyone who works.
passageZh: 我家有五口人。爸爸是医生，在大医院工作，帮助病人康复。妈妈是护士，在同一家医院照顾病人。叔叔是司机，从早到晚开公交车。姑姑是老师，在小学工作，爱她的学生。每份工作都重要，我们尊重所有劳动者。晚饭桌上，我们常聊聊各自工作或上学的一天。爸爸讲他怎样帮助病人，妈妈讲她照顾的病人。叔叔即使路忙也小心开车。每份工作技能不同，但都在服务人。长大后我们可能选不同工作，但应始终尊重每一位劳动者。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1原创（What does he/she do? He/She is a...）

title: Night Workers
passage: Some people work at night when we sleep. A doctor works at night in the hospital and helps sick people. A nurse looks after patients through the night. A driver drives the night bus across the quiet city. A firefighter stays ready to keep us safe. They work at night so we can rest well. They keep the city safe. They love their jobs, and it feels great! We should say thank you to these night heroes. When we sleep in warm beds, these workers keep the streets lit and safe. A night doctor writes notes after each check, and a night driver greets sleepy passengers. A firefighter checks the truck every evening so it is ready. We seldom see them, but their quiet effort surrounds us. A small thank-you card or a kind word can make a night worker feel proud of the job.
passageZh: 有些人在我们睡觉时的夜里工作。医生夜里在医院帮助病人，护士整夜照顾病人，司机开夜班车穿过安静的城市，消防员随时待命保护我们安全。他们夜里工作，让我们好好休息。他们保卫城市安全，热爱工作，感觉很棒！我们应该向这些夜班英雄说谢谢。我们在暖床上睡觉时，这些工作者让街道明亮、安全。夜班医生每次检查后写记录，夜班司机向困倦乘客问好。消防员每晚检查消防车，随时待命。我们很少见到他们，但他们安静的努力围绕着我们。一张感谢卡或一句善意的话，就能让夜班工作者为工作自豪。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1原创（He/She works at night. They keep the city safe.）

title: The Journey of Bread
passage: How does bread come to our table? First, the farmer grows wheat in the field. Then, the worker makes the wheat into flour. Next, the baker mixes the flour and bakes the bread in the oven. Finally, the driver delivers the bread to the shop. Many people work together to make one loaf of bread. Each job has a special role. Together, they make bread possible. This shows us that every worker matters. The farmer waits through rain and sun for the wheat to ripen. The worker cleans the grain before grinding it into fine flour. The baker mixes yeast, water and flour, then waits for the dough to rise. The driver checks the bread carefully before delivering it. Behind every slice of bread stand many pairs of hard-working hands, which teaches us to value food and thank workers.
passageZh: 面包怎样来到我们餐桌？首先，农民在田里种小麦；然后，工人把小麦磨成面粉；接着，面包师把面粉和好，放进烤箱烤成面包；最后，司机把面包送到商店。很多人一起努力才做出一条面包。每份工作都有特别作用，大家一起才有了面包。这告诉我们每个劳动者都重要。农民经历日晒雨淋等待小麦成熟。工人先清理谷物，再磨成细面粉。面包师把酵母、水、面粉和好，等面团发酵。司机送货前仔细检查面包。每一片面包背后都有许多双勤劳的手，这教会我们珍惜食物、感谢劳动者。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1原创（First... Then... Next... Finally...）

title: My Dream Job
passage: I want to be a scientist when I grow up. I want to work in a lab and study plants. I will work with books and tools. I love doing experiments because I want to help people. My friend Lily wants to be a painter. She works in a studio and loves drawing. My brother wants to be a pilot. He wants to fly in the sky. I believe in myself, and I will study hard to make my dream come true. In the lab, I will read books about plants and write down my observations. My teacher encourages me to ask questions and never fear mistakes. Lily practises drawing every evening and hopes to paint people and nature. My brother builds paper planes and dreams of flying one day. A dream is just a wish until study and action turn it into a real goal.
passageZh: 我长大后想当科学家，想在实验室研究植物。我和书、工具打交道。我热爱做实验，因为我想帮助人们。朋友莉莉想当画家，在画室工作，热爱画画。我弟弟想当飞行员，想在天上飞。我相信自己，会努力学习实现梦想。在实验室，我读植物书，记下观察。老师鼓励我提问、不怕犯错。莉莉每晚练画，希望画人物和自然。弟弟折纸飞机，梦想有一天飞翔。梦想只是愿望，直到学习和行动把它变成真正的目标。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1原创（I want to be a... and work in a...）

title: People in Our City
passage: Our city has many hard-working people. A farmer grows vegetables in the field. A painter draws beautiful pictures on the wall. A cook makes delicious food in the restaurant. A policeman helps people and keeps the street safe. A pilot flies a plane high in the sky. We can guess the job from clues: where they work, what tool they use, and what they do. Each person does a special job, and together our city runs well. On our city map, we match each worker to his or her workplace. A farmer's field is outside the town, a painter's studio has brushes, and a cook's kitchen smells of food. A policeman walks the beat, and a pilot sits high in the sky. Clues like place, tool and action help us guess the job. Every worker keeps the city running, so we should be thankful to them all.
passageZh: 我们城市有很多勤劳的人。农民在田里种蔬菜，画家在墙上画美丽的画，厨师在餐厅做好吃的，警察帮助人们、维护街道安全，飞行员在高空开飞机。我们可以根据线索猜职业：在哪里工作、用什么工具、做什么事。每个人做特别的工作，城市才能良好运转。在城市地图上，我们把每位工作者和工作场所配对。农民的田在城外，画家的画室有画笔，厨师的厨房飘着食物香。警察巡逻，飞行员坐在高空。场所、工具、行为等线索帮我们猜职业。每位工作者都让城市运转，我们应感谢他们所有人。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1原创（职业词汇 + 线索推理）

unit: Unit 2 How do you feel today?
title: How Do You Feel Today?
passage: Today is Monday. Daming feels sad because he can't take part in the singing show. He has a cough and he is ill. Amy feels happy because her best friend comes back to school after a long illness. Lingling feels surprised because her mum gives her a new storybook. Sam feels angry because his little brother breaks his toy car. Feelings change all the time. We can talk about our feelings. Feelings come and go like weather, and none of them is wrong. After seeing the doctor, Daming drinks warm water and rests at home. Amy shares her happy news with the whole class. Lingling reads her new storybook before bed. Sam's mother helps him fix the toy car, so his anger slowly melts. Talking about feelings keeps our heart light and helps friends understand us.
passageZh: 今天星期一。大明难过，因为他不能参加歌唱表演，他咳嗽生病了。埃米开心，因为她最好的朋友病了很久后回到学校。玲玲惊喜，因为妈妈送她一本新故事书。萨姆生气，因为弟弟弄坏了他的玩具汽车。情绪一直在变。我们可以说出自己的情绪。情绪像天气一样来去，没有一种是错的。看完医生，大明喝温水在家休息。埃米把开心的消息告诉全班。玲玲睡前读新故事书。妈妈帮萨姆修好玩具车，他的生气慢慢消散。说出情绪让心情轻松，也帮朋友理解我们。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U2原创（I'm feeling... / How do you feel? 六种情绪）

unit: Unit 2 How do you feel today?
title: A Surprise Party
passage: Yesterday was Lily's birthday. Her friends planned a surprise party. When Lily walked into the room, all her friends jumped out and shouted, "Happy birthday!" Lily felt very excited and surprised. She clapped her hands and smiled. She saw a big cake and many gifts. She felt happy all evening. Her mother took photos. It was a wonderful party, and nobody felt sad. Before the party, friends hid behind the door and turned off the light. Lily did not know anyone was coming, so her surprise was real. After singing the birthday song, Lily made a wish and blew out the candles. They kept the cake for Grandma to taste the next day. A surprise party shows how much friends care, and it leaves happy memories for years.
passageZh: 昨天是莉莉的生日，朋友们准备了惊喜派对。当莉莉走进房间，大家跳出来喊：“生日快乐！”莉莉又激动又惊喜，她拍手微笑。她看到大蛋糕和许多礼物，整晚都很开心。妈妈拍了照片。派对很棒，没人难过。派对前，朋友躲在门后，关掉灯。莉莉不知道有人来，所以惊喜很真实。唱完生日歌，莉莉许愿、吹蜡烛。他们把蛋糕留到第二天给奶奶尝。惊喜派对说明朋友有多在乎，留下多年的快乐回忆。

unit: Unit 2 How do you feel today?
title: Why Are You Angry?
passage: Tom was angry this morning because his brother had taken his pencil case without asking. Tom's face was red, and he spoke loudly. Then his mother came and said sorry for his brother. They shared the pencils together. Tom slowly felt calm and happy again. When we are angry, we should take a deep breath and talk kindly. Being angry is OK, but we should not shout at others. After calming down, Tom helped his brother pick up the pencils. They agreed to ask before taking each other's things. His mother praised both boys for sharing. That evening, Tom drew a picture and gave it to his brother as a peace gift. When we manage anger kindly, a small quarrel can end in friendship instead of a fight.
passageZh: 汤姆今早生气，因为他弟弟没问就拿走了他的铅笔盒。汤姆脸涨红，大声说话。后来妈妈替弟弟道了歉，他们一起分用铅笔。汤姆慢慢平静、又开心起来。生气时我们应深呼吸、好好说。生气很正常，但不应对别人大喊。平静后，汤姆帮弟弟捡起铅笔。他们约定拿彼此东西前先问。妈妈表扬两个孩子分享。晚上，汤姆画了一幅画送给弟弟讲和。善意处理愤怒，小争吵也能以友谊结束，而不是吵架。

unit: Unit 2 How do you feel today?
title: A Worried Test Day
passage: Today we have an English test. At first, Meimei feels worried. She thinks she can't finish the paper. Her hands are cold, and her heart beats fast. But the teacher says, "Don't worry. Take your time." Meimei takes a deep breath and reads each question carefully. She finishes the paper. When the teacher says she did well, Meimei feels happy and proud. Worry is normal, but trying our best helps. Meimei writes her name carefully and checks each answer twice. When she finishes early, she sits quietly and thinks again. The test is not easy, but she does her best and that is enough. After school, she plays outside to relax. Being worried is natural before a test, but confidence and careful work turn worry into calm.
passageZh: 今天有英语考试。起初美美感到担心，她觉得自己做不完试卷，手发凉、心跳快。但老师说：“别担心，慢慢来。”美美深呼吸，仔细读每道题，完成了试卷。老师说她考得好时，美美开心又自豪。担心很正常，但尽力就有帮助。美美认真写名字，把每题检查两遍。提前做完时，她安静坐着再想一遍。考试不简单，但她尽力了，这就够了。放学后她出去玩放松。考前担心很自然，但自信和认真把担心变成平静。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U2原创（worried → happy，because原因）

unit: Unit 2 How do you feel today?
title: Feelings Are OK
passage: Everyone has feelings. Sometimes we feel happy, and sometimes we feel sad or angry. It is OK to feel every emotion. When we are sad, we can talk to a friend or a parent. When we are excited, we can share the joy. Reading a storybook or playing sports can also make us happy. —I feel like singing when I am happy. Sharing feelings helps us feel better. We should be kind to ourselves and to others. At school, our feelings wall shows a happy face, a sad face and an angry face. Children place a small card beside the face they feel today. The teacher never laughs at any feeling. A walk, a hug or a kind word can comfort a sad friend. When we name our feelings instead of hiding them, we grow emotionally and make kinder friends.
passageZh: 每个人都有情绪。有时开心，有时难过或生气。每种情绪都正常。难过时可以找朋友或父母聊聊，激动时可以分享喜悦。读故事书或做运动也能让我们开心。开心时我想唱歌。说出情绪让我们好起来，我们要善待自己和他人。学校里的情绪墙有开心、难过、生气的脸。孩子把小卡片放在自己今天的情绪旁边。老师从不嘲笑任何情绪。散步、拥抱或一句善言能安慰难过的朋友。说出而不是隐藏情绪，我们在情感上成长，交到更友善的朋友。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U2原创（I feel...like... / 情绪分享）

title: The School Talent Show
passage: Our school had a talent show yesterday. Lingling is good at dancing. She danced very beautifully on the stage. Amy is good at singing. She sang a sweet song. Daming is not good at dancing, but he wants to try. Daming was practising the dance because he loved dancing. At the show, everyone clapped. Everyone's got talent, and trying is the first step. Before the show, we practised on the stage in turns. Lingling's dance steps were smooth, and Amy's voice was clear. Daming watched and copied each move, even when he stepped on feet. The teacher clapped and told us that practice makes perfect. On show night, the whole hall cheered. Talent is a gift, but daily practice turns that gift into a beautiful performance.
passageZh: 我们学校昨天举办了才艺表演。玲玲擅长跳舞，在舞台上跳得很美。埃米擅长唱歌，唱了一首甜美的歌。大明不擅长跳舞，但他想试试。大明在练舞，因为他热爱跳舞。表演上大家都鼓掌。每个人都有才能，尝试是第一步。表演前，我们轮流在舞台上练习。玲玲舞步流畅，埃米嗓音清亮。大明看着模仿每个动作，即使踩到脚。老师鼓掌说熟能生巧。表演之夜，全场欢呼。才能是天赋，但每天练习把天赋变成精彩演出。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3原创（I can... / What are you doing? Because I love...）

title: Keep Trying
passage: Peter wants to learn to swim, so he practises in the small pool. At first, he puts his face in the water and feels afraid. He fails and stands up. Why? Because the water feels cold. His friend encourages him, "Keep trying — that's real talent!" Peter practises every afternoon. Little by little, he can float and then swim a little. Failures are part of learning. Today he can swim ten metres. He feels proud. Peter's coach showed him how to hold his breath and move his arms. At first, water went into his mouth, but he did not run away. He watched good swimmers and copied their breathing. His parents cheered from the poolside every afternoon. Small steps every day add up to a big change, and never giving up is what real talent is made of.
passageZh: 彼得想学游泳，于是他在小泳池里练习。起初他把脸埋进水里，感到害怕，失败后站起来。为什么？因为水冷。朋友鼓励他：“不断尝试，这才是真正的才能！”彼得每天下午练习，渐渐地他能漂浮，然后游一点。失败是学习的一部分。今天他能游十米了，他很自豪。教练教彼得如何憋气、摆臂。起初水灌进嘴里，但他没有跑开。他观察优秀游泳者，模仿呼吸。每天下午父母在池边为他加油。每天一小步积累成大改变，永不放弃正是真正才能的构成。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3原创（I'm trying to... / Keep trying — that's real talent!）

title: Kinds of Talent
passage: People have different kinds of talent. I've got picture talent — I love drawing animals. My deskmate has word talent — she writes nice stories. Tom has body talent — he jumps high and runs fast. Lily has number talent — she counts quickly. Jack has musical talent — he sings and plays the piano. What kind of talent do you have? You can find your talent by trying many things. Know your talents — that's the first step to growth! We make a talent board in class and write our names under the right kind. A child who draws well puts a star under picture talent. We interview each other and share one small strength. No talent is better than another; they are simply different. Knowing what we are good at helps us choose hobbies we truly enjoy and grow in.
passageZh: 人们有不同类型的才能。我有绘画才能——爱画动物；同桌有文字才能——写好故事；汤姆有身体才能——跳得高、跑得快；莉莉有数字才能——算得快；杰克有音乐才能——唱歌、弹钢琴。你有哪种才能？多尝试就能发现。认识自己的才能，是成长第一步！我们在班里做才能板，把名字写在对应类型下。画得好的孩子把星贴在绘画才能下。我们互相访谈，分享一个小长处。没有哪种才能更高贵，只是不同。认识自己擅长什么，帮我们选真正喜欢的爱好并成长。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3原创（I've got... talent: picture/word/body/number/musical）

title: My Family's Talents
passage: Last week we made a Family Talents Board. I asked, "What is your dad good at?" Mum said, "Your dad is good at fixing things. He has body talent." Dad asked me, "Can you teach me to draw?" I have picture talent, so I taught him a simple cat. My little sister has musical talent; she sings every day. We wrote each person's talent on the board. Family talent is love plus support plus growth. It was fun to learn about each other. On the board, we also write how we can help each other. Dad fixes a broken chair and teaches me to use a small tool. Mum sings me a song when I cannot sleep. My sister teaches me a few dance steps. We take a photo of the board and stick it on the fridge. A family that shares talents grows closer and supports every member's dream.
passageZh: 上周我们做了一块“家庭才能板”。我问：“爸爸擅长什么？”妈妈说：“你爸爸擅长修理东西，他有身体才能。”爸爸问我：“你能教我画画吗？”我有绘画才能，就教他画了一只简单的猫。小妹妹有音乐才能，每天唱歌。我们把每个人的才能写在板上。家庭才能是爱、支持加成长。了解彼此很有趣。板上我们还写下如何互相帮助。爸爸修好坏椅子，教我用小工具。妈妈在我睡不着时唱歌。妹妹教我几个舞步。我们给板拍照，贴在冰箱上。分享才能的家庭更亲密，支持每位成员的梦想。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3原创（What is your dad good at? Can you teach me?）

title: A Little Bird Finds Its Talent
passage: Little Chick wanted to join the talent show. "What are you good at?" asked the teacher. "I don't know," said Chick. He saw Duck dancing and Bird singing. He cried, "I am not good at anything." Mouse came and said, "Don't cry. What do you like doing?" "I like running," said Chick. "Then practise running!" Chick ran every day. In the show, he ran the fastest and won first prize. "I've got body talent!" said Chick. Courage and practice turn a try into talent. After winning, Chick did not stop running. He still practises every morning and joins other races. Mouse explains that everyone first feels unsure, but trying reveals a hidden strength. Duck and Bird cheer for their friend even though their talents differ. The show teaches the whole forest: courage to try matters more than being perfect at once.
passageZh: 小鸡想参加才艺表演。“你擅长什么？”老师问。“我不知道，”小鸡说。他看到鸭子跳舞、小鸟唱歌，哭着说：“我什么都不擅长。”老鼠走过来说：“别哭，你喜欢做什么？”“我喜欢跑步，”小鸡说。“那就练习跑步！”小鸡每天跑。表演上他跑得最快，得了一等奖。“我有身体才能！”小鸡说。勇气加练习，让尝试变成才能。获奖后，小鸡没有停止跑步。他仍每天早上练习，参加其他比赛。老鼠解释说，每个人起初都会不确定，但尝试会揭示隐藏的长处。鸭子和鸟虽然才能不同，仍为朋友加油。表演教会整个森林：敢于尝试比一开始就完美更重要。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3原创（才艺发现 + 坚持练习）

title: Parts of a Plant
passage: Look at a green plant. What's this? It's a root. The root grows under the ground and holds the plant. It takes water from the soil. This is a stem. The stem is long and thin, and it carries water up to the top. These are leaves. The leaves are big and green and make food for the plant. This is a flower. It looks beautiful and smells nice. Inside the flower, there is a seed. A new plant can grow from that seed. On a spring morning, our teacher brings a small potted plant to class. We pass it around and touch the soft leaf carefully. We draw the plant in our notebook and label each part. The root hides under the soil, so we cannot see it, yet it keeps the plant steady. Knowing the parts of a plant helps us understand how it drinks, grows and finally blooms.
passageZh: 看一棵绿色植物。这是什么？这是根，根长在地下固定植物，从土壤吸水。这是茎，又长又细，把水送到顶部。这些是叶子，又大又绿，为植物制造养分。这是花，美丽又香。花里面有一粒种子，新植物能从种子长出来。春天的一个早上，老师带一盆小植物到教室。我们轮流传递，轻轻摸叶子。我们在笔记本上画下植物，给每个部分标注名称。根藏在土里看不见，却让植物站稳。认识植物各部分，帮我们理解它怎样喝水、生长、最终开花。

title: We Are Planting Seeds
passage: Today our class is in the school garden. We're planting seeds in the soft soil. Look! She's watering the flowers gently. They're digging a small hole with their hands. I'm putting a seed into the earth and covering it. —What are you doing? —I'm watering my pot. Seeds need water and sun every day. We will check our plants tomorrow. We feel excited because we are growing something. We work in small groups so nobody is left alone. One child digs, another waters, and another writes the date on a stick label. We keep the pot on the windowsill where it receives soft sun. Each day we count the new leaves and write a short note. Growing together in the garden teaches us patience and care, and we wait happily for the first green shoot.
passageZh: 今天我们班在学校花园里。我们正在软土里播种。看！她在轻轻浇花，他们在用手挖小坑。我正把种子放进土里盖上。——你在做什么？——我在浇我的花盆。种子每天都需要水和阳光。我们明天来看植物。我们很激动，因为正在种东西。我们小组合作，不让任何人落单。一个挖土，一个浇水，一个在小标签上写日期。我们把花盆放在窗台，接受柔和阳光。每天数新叶，写一句短记。在花园一起种植教会我们耐心和照顾，我们快乐地等待第一棵绿芽。

title: My Seed Grows
passage: On Day 1, I planted a seed in a pot. I watered it every morning and put it in the sun. For many days, I saw no change, and I felt worried. But I kept taking care of it. On Day 10, a small green shoot came up! I was very happy. Now the plant is growing. Its leaves are green, and it stands straight. Yesterday I added a little water. Plants need care, just like us. I feel proud of my little plant. After the shoot came up, I turned the pot a little every week so every side received light. I never poured too much water, because wet soil can rot the seed. My grandfather taught me to watch the plant rather than hurry it. Now the stem is straight and the leaves shine in the sun. A plant grows in its own time, just like we grow day by day.
passageZh: 第一天，我在花盆种下一粒种子。每天早上浇水、放在阳光下。很多天没变化，我有点担心，但继续照顾它。第10天，一棵小绿芽冒出来！我非常开心。现在植物正在生长，叶子翠绿、笔直挺立。昨天我又浇了点水。植物像我们一样需要照顾，我为我的小植物自豪。芽长出后，我每周把花盆转一点，让每面都见光。我从不浇太多水，因为湿土会让种子腐烂。爷爷教我观察植物而不是催促它。现在茎笔直，叶子在阳光下发亮。植物按自己的时间生长，就像我们一天天长大。

title: Plants Are Used to Make Things
passage: Plants are very useful in our daily life. Plants are used to make paper; this page comes from wood. A cotton shirt is made from the cotton plant. A wooden chair comes from a tree. A bamboo basket is made of bamboo. We get food, clothes and medicine from plants. But plastic does not come from plants. We should protect plants because they give us so much. Reducing paper also helps save trees. Paper comes from trees, so using both sides of a sheet saves wood. Cotton grows in warm fields, and farmers pick it by hand or machine. Wood is dried before it becomes a chair or table. Bamboo grows fast and returns quickly after cutting. When we choose plant-based things, we should also use them carefully and never waste, so forests stay green for children in the future.
passageZh: 植物在日常生活中非常有用。纸是用植物做的，这页纸来自木材；棉衬衫来自棉花；木椅子来自树木；竹筐由竹子编成。我们从植物获得食物、衣服和药。但塑料不来自植物。我们应该保护植物，因为它们给予我们很多。节约用纸也能帮助保护树木。纸来自树木，所以双面用纸节省木材。棉花长在温暖田里，农民用手或机器采摘。木材干燥后才做成桌椅。竹子长得快，砍后很快再生。选择植物制品时，我们也应爱惜、不浪费，让森林为未来的孩子保持绿色。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U4原创（Plants are used to make...）

title: Grandpa the Rice Scientist
passage: My grandpa is a scientist. He works in the fields and studies rice. He has a dream: to grow tall rice plants with big grains. When he was young, he worked hard every day in the sun. He watched the plants, watered them, and wrote down his findings. Now his rice grows strong. People around the country enjoy the rice. Plants feed the world. Grandpa teaches me patience: with water, sun and time, we can grow tall and strong, just like a good plant. Grandpa gets up before sunrise and walks through the fields. He writes the height of each rice plant in a small notebook. He talks to the plants as if they were old friends. His dream feeds many people, and it teaches me that hard work starts small. When I grow up, I want to study nature too and help feed the world, just like Grandpa.
passageZh: 我爷爷是科学家，在田里研究水稻。他有个梦想：种出高个子、谷粒饱满的水稻。年轻时他每天在阳光下辛勤工作，观察、浇水、记录发现。现在他的水稻长得强壮，全国人民都吃到这种米。植物养活世界。爷爷教会我耐心：有水、阳光和时间，我们就能像好植物一样长得又高又壮。爷爷日出前起床，走过田埂。他在小本子记下每株水稻的高度。他像对老朋友一样对植物说话。他的梦想养活许多人，也教会我：努力从细小处开始。长大后，我也想研究自然、像爷爷一样帮助养活世界。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U4原创（科学家梦想 + 植物生长寓意）

title: Our School Events
passage: Our school has many interesting events every term. There is an art festival in spring. There are games at the school picnic. There is a sports meeting on the playground. We plant trees on Tree-planting Day. There is a talent show on the stage. There are many books in the reading corner. Last month we joined the art festival. This week we went on a field trip. Each event gives us fun and new friends. At the art festival, we hang our drawings along the corridor. At the picnic, parents bring dishes to share under the trees. The sports meeting fills the playground with running and cheering. The talent show lets every child show one small strength. The reading corner always has new books to borrow. School events join learning and fun, and they make the year feel lively and full.
passageZh: 我们学校每学期有很多有趣活动。春天有艺术节，学校野餐有游戏，操场上有运动会，植树日我们种树，舞台上有才艺表演，阅读角有很多书。上个月我们参加艺术节，这周去了实地考察。每个活动都给我们快乐和新朋友。艺术节我们把画沿走廊挂起。野餐时家长带菜到树下分享。运动会让操场满是奔跑和欢呼。才艺表演让每个孩子展示一个小长处。阅读角总有新书可借。学校活动把学习和乐趣结合，让这一年生动充实。

title: On the Field Trip
passage: Today our class goes on a field trip to the forest. We look around and ask questions. —Is there a bird in the tree? —Yes, there is. —Are there any flowers on the ground? —Yes, there are. —Is there a small plant under the stone? —No, there isn't. —Are there any insects on the leaf? —No, there aren't. Our teacher helps us read nature. We walk quietly and watch carefully. The forest is full of surprises. Our teacher gives each group a small notebook to draw what we see. We compare notes about the birds and flowers we find. The forest keeper warns us not to touch unknown insects or pick rare plants. Walking quietly lets real animals come near without fear. Field trips teach us to observe nature with respect, and every small discovery feels exciting.
passageZh: 今天全班去森林实地考察。我们四处观察提问。——树上有鸟吗？——是的，有。——地上有花吗？——是的，有。——石头下面有小植物吗？——不，没有。——叶子上有昆虫吗？——不，没有。老师帮我们读懂自然。我们安静走路、仔细观察，森林充满惊喜。老师给每组一个小本子，画下所见。我们比较记录找到的鸟和花。森林管理员提醒我们不碰不明昆虫、不摘稀有植物。安静走路，让真正的动物不惧靠近。实地考察教我们尊重自然地观察，每个小发现都令人兴奋。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U5原创（Is there...? / Are there...? 及答语）

title: The Baby Bird's Homecoming
passage: On the field trip, Lanlan and Weiwei find a baby bird on the ground. It fell off the tree. There is no nest under it. They do not touch it, because its mother may be near. They call the teacher, and the forest keeper comes quickly. Is there a mother bird nearby? Yes, she is waiting in the branches. The keeper climbs the tree and puts the baby bird back into the nest. The mother bird comes back. We feel happy to have helped a little bird. Before calling the keeper, the children backed away slowly so the baby bird was not frightened. The mother bird watched from a branch and did not attack anyone. After the rescue, our teacher explained that baby birds learn to fly from low branches. We wrote a short report about the day. Helping one small creature teaches us kindness, and it becomes our favourite memory of the trip.
passageZh: 实地考察时，兰兰和伟伟在地上发现一只雏鸟，它从树上掉下，下面没有巢。他们没有碰它，因为鸟妈妈可能就在附近。他们叫来老师，森林管理员很快赶来。附近有鸟妈妈吗？是的，她在枝头等着。管理员爬上树把雏鸟放回巢里，鸟妈妈回来了。帮助一只小鸟让我们很开心。叫管理员前，孩子们慢慢后退，以免吓到雏鸟。鸟妈妈在枝头看着，没有攻击任何人。救援后，老师解释雏鸟从低枝学飞。我们写了一篇关于这一天的短报告。帮助一个小生命教会我们善良，它成为这次旅行最美好的回忆。

title: My Favourite School Event
passage: My favourite school event is the school picnic. There is a big tent on the grass. There are balloons in the sky. There is a table full of food, like sandwiches and fruit. Are there any games? Yes, there are. We play games and share food with classmates. I have fun because my friends are with me. Last year we sat under a big tree and laughed. Events like this make school warm and joyful. At the picnic, we spread a big cloth and pass dishes around. The balloons dance in the light wind, and music plays softly in the background. We play simple games like guessing riddles and passing a ball. My grandmother came along and told stories about her school picnic years ago. The best events are not the expensive ones, but the ones shared with people we love.
passageZh: 我最喜欢的学校活动是学校野餐。草地上有一顶大帐篷，天上有气球，桌上摆满三明治、水果等食物。有游戏吗？有的。我们玩游戏、和同学分享食物。因为朋友在身边，我玩得很开心。去年我们坐在大树下欢笑。这样的活动让学校温暖又快乐。野餐时我们铺开大布，传菜分享。气球在微风中摇摆，音乐轻轻播放。我们玩猜谜、传球等简单游戏。奶奶也来了，讲她多年前学校野餐的故事。最好的活动不是昂贵的，而是和爱的人一起分享的。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U5原创（My favourite event; There is/are; because）

title: Last Term's Events
passage: Last term our school had many events. In October, we had an art festival. We drew pictures and sang English songs. I wrote Chinese words on a big piece of red paper, and my teacher said they looked nice. In November, we went on a field trip to Green Forest. We saw tall trees and lovely birds. We did not touch the baby bird we found. In December, we held a small talent show. We learned a lot and made new friends. School events make every term colourful. After the art festival, our class put the best drawings in a folder. On the field trip, we collected dry leaves to press in books. The talent show had only a few children on stage, but every classmate clapped loudly. We write down each event in our school diary and read it at the end of term. Looking back, every event taught us something new and brought us closer as a class.

title: What Are You Wearing?
passage: Today is the school fashion day. —What are you wearing today, Daming? —I'm wearing a T-shirt and shorts. It's hot today. Lingling is wearing her favourite blue dress. Amy is wearing a pink skirt and a white shirt. Sam is wearing a yellow jacket and grey trousers. We wear different clothes for different weather. On hot days, light cotton keeps us cool; on cold days, layers trap warm air. We check the forecast in the morning before choosing what to wear. A hat protects the face from sun, and gloves keep hands warm in winter. Clothes are not only pretty; they protect our body and make us feel comfortable all day.

title: At the Clothes Shop
passage: Mum and I are in a clothes shop. —What do you want? —I'd like a red skirt, please. —What size? —Size M, please. The shop assistant shows me a blue sweater, too. It's warm and soft. Dad would like a new pair of shoes; he needs them for walking. Mum would like a cotton scarf. We talk about colour, size and material before we buy. Shopping for clothes is fun when we know what we want. The shop assistant folds each piece neatly and shows us the mirror. We check the size by trying on a small, a medium and a large. Colour matters too: red looks bright, while blue feels calm. My mother always asks about the material before paying. Shopping becomes easy when we know what we want, what size fits and what material suits the season.
passageZh: 我和妈妈在服装店。——你想要什么？——我想要一条红裙子。——什么尺码？——M码。店员还给我看一件蓝毛衣，又暖又软。爸爸想要一双新鞋，走路需要；妈妈想要一条棉围巾。买之前我们讨论颜色、尺码和材质。知道自己想要什么，买衣服很有趣。店员把每件衣服叠整齐，带我们照镜子。我们试小、中、大码看合身。颜色也重要：红色鲜亮，蓝色安静。妈妈付款前总问材质。知道想要什么、什么码合身、什么材质适合季节，购物就变得轻松。

title: Made of Old Things
passage: We can make cool clothes from old things. My dress is made of an old black bag. My vest is made of old plastic bags. My hat is made of old paper. My bag is made of an old T-shirt. It's cool because we reuse old things and help the Earth. We follow Reduce, Reuse, Recycle. Old cloth does not need to become rubbish. With a little creativity, we can turn it into something new. Before making something, we wash and dry the old material carefully. Scissors, glue and a needle are kept away from small children. We draw a simple shape on the old cloth first, then cut it slowly. Old T-shirts become bags, and old socks become soft toys. Reusing things saves money and reduces rubbish, and it teaches children to be creative and kind to the Earth.
passageZh: 我们可以用旧东西做很酷的衣服。我的连衣裙用旧黑包做成，背心用旧塑料袋，帽子用旧纸，包用旧T恤。它很酷，因为我们重复利用旧物、保护地球。我们遵循“减少、重复利用、回收”。旧布不必变成垃圾，一点创意就能把它变成新东西。做东西前，我们先把旧材料洗净晾干。剪刀、胶水、针放在小孩够不到的地方。先在旧布上画简单形状，再慢慢剪。旧T恤变成包，旧袜子变成软玩具。重复利用省钱、减少垃圾，也教会孩子有创意、对地球友善。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U6原创（Made of... / Why? Because... / 3R环保）

title: Uniforms Help Us
passage: Many people wear uniforms. A policeman wears a dark uniform and helps keep us safe. A doctor wears a white coat in the hospital. A firefighter wears a special suit to fight fire. A pilot wears a uniform in the cockpit. Uniforms tell us what job a person does, and they also protect the worker. We can recognise a helper at once by the uniform. Different uniforms have special colours and marks that we can recognise from far away. A doctor's white coat keeps clothes clean, and a firefighter's suit resists heat. A pilot's uniform looks neat inside the cockpit. When we see a uniform, we know who can help us in trouble. Uniforms are practical, and they also show pride in the job a person does.

title: Our Green Fashion Show
passage: Last Friday, our class held a green fashion show. We used old materials. I wore a hat made of old paper and a vest made of old plastic bags. My friend walked out in a dress made of an old bag. We walked on the small stage and smiled. A teacher asked what I was wearing. I said I was wearing a hat and a vest made of old plastic bags. The teachers clapped and said our ideas were creative. They want to make one too. Green fashion is fun and kind to the Earth. Before the show, we spent two afternoons cutting and gluing old materials. Each model walked slowly on the small stage and introduced the outfit. The audience asked, "What is it made of?" and we answered with pride. Some teachers even joined in and made a hat from old paper. Green fashion proves that beauty and care for the Earth can go together, and everyone went home inspired.

title: A snack survey at school
passage:
What snacks do you like? Chocolate, chips, biscuits, candies or fruit? We asked fifty primary school students. Seventeen students love chips. Thirteen students like biscuits, twelve love chocolate and eight like candies. The snacks high in fat, salt and sugar are their favourites.
Too many of these snacks are not good for us. One bar of chocolate has about ten teaspoons of sugar. A bag of chips every day is like drinking five bottles of oil a year! So, next time you have a snack, make healthy choices.
The survey covered fifty students from two Grade Five classes. It showed that salty and sugary snacks were the most popular, while fruit and plain vegetables were chosen by only a few children. The health teacher used the results to give a talk at assembly. She explained that too much sugar can make teeth hurt and too much oil can make the body heavy. After the talk, many students started choosing an apple or a handful of nuts instead of a bag of chips. Small daily choices, the teacher said, add up to a healthy body over the years.
passageZh:
你喜欢什么零食？巧克力、炸薯条、饼干、糖果还是水果？我们问了五十名小学生。十七名学生喜欢炸薯条，十三名喜欢饼干，十二名喜欢巧克力，八名喜欢糖果。那些高脂肪、高盐、高糖的零食是他们的最爱。
吃太多这类零食对我们不好。一块巧克力大约含有十茶匙糖。每天吃一袋炸薯条，一年下来就像喝了五瓶油！所以下次吃零食时，要做出健康的选择。
调查覆盖了两个五年级班的五十名学生。结果显示咸甜零食最受欢迎，水果和清炒蔬菜只有少数孩子选择。保健老师用结果在集会上做了讲座。她解释糖太多会伤牙，油太多会让身体变沉。讲座后许多学生开始选苹果或一小把坚果，而不是一袋炸薯条。老师说，每天的小选择日积月累就成就健康的身体。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上听力脚本U1（Activity 3  snack survey）

title: A letter from your stomach
passage:
Dear Sally,
I am your stomach, and I have a problem. This is a bad day for me again!
Every morning, I get only a few biscuits. That is not enough! A good breakfast needs bread, milk, eggs, fruit and vegetables. With only biscuits, I feel hungry all morning.
At lunch you eat too much meat and no vegetables. The food is heavy, so I work slowly. That is why you feel sleepy in the afternoon.
At dinner you always eat too quickly. Please eat slowly. I need a long time to work, and I get tired, too.
Sally, please change your eating habits. Choose healthy food and eat slowly. Then I will be healthy, and you will feel good all day.
With love,
Your stomach

亲爱的萨莉：
我是你的胃，我有一个问题。今天对我来说又是糟糕的一天！

你的胃

title: My healthy eating day
passage:
My name is Amy. I want to tell you about my eating habits.
For breakfast, I often have milk, bread and an egg. Mum says breakfast is very important. At school, I have lunch with my friends. I eat noodles or rice, and some meat or fish. I also eat vegetables like tomatoes and potatoes.
Before, I only ate fast food like hamburgers. But fast food has too much oil and salt. Now I know we should not take too much sugar. I drink water every day, not cola.
After dinner, I eat an apple or a banana. Healthy food makes me feel well and study better. I hope you can eat well too!
passageZh:
我叫艾米，想跟大家说说我的饮食习惯。
早餐我常吃牛奶、面包和一个鸡蛋，妈妈说早餐非常重要。在学校我和朋友一起吃午饭，吃面条或米饭，再来点肉或鱼，还吃西红柿、土豆之类的蔬菜。
以前我只吃汉堡之类的快餐，但快餐油和盐太多。现在我知道不该摄入太多糖，我每天喝水，不喝可乐。
晚饭后我吃一个苹果或一根香蕉。健康食物让我感觉良好、学习更好。希望你也能吃得健康！

title: Go, slow, whoa! Know your food groups
passage:
Want to eat right? Remember three words: Go, slow, whoa!
Go foods help us grow and give us energy. Tomatoes, grapes and oats are Go foods. They are full of vitamins and fibre, so we can eat them often.
Slow foods are nice but we should not take too much. Biscuits, juice and nuts are Slow foods. They have some sugar or fat, so be slow and enjoy just a little.
Whoa foods make our body slow. Chips, candies and cakes are Whoa foods. They have a lot of fat, salt or sugar, so we should say no.
Next time you choose a snack, ask yourself: Go, slow, or whoa?
passageZh:
想吃得健康吗？记住三个词：畅吃、慢吃、停住！
“畅吃”食物帮我们长大、给我们能量。西红柿、葡萄、燕麦属于畅吃类，富含维生素和纤维，可以常吃。
“慢吃”食物不错，但别吃太多。饼干、果汁、坚果属于慢吃类，含有一些糖或脂肪，要慢一点、只吃一点。
“停住”食物让身体变迟缓。炸薯条、糖果、蛋糕属于停住类，脂肪、盐或糖很多，我们应该说不。
下次选零食时，问问自己：畅吃、慢吃，还是停住？
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Fuel up U1+知识清单

title: A healthy lunch at the school canteen
passage:
Today is Monday. The school canteen has a new menu. There is rice, fish, beef, salad, soup, fruit and some bread.
Daming looks at the menu. He wants fish and beef, but there are no vegetables on his plate. The teacher says, "Don't take too much meat! You should have some vegetables." Daming looks again and adds some tomatoes and potatoes.
Amy chooses fish, rice and a bowl of vegetable soup. She takes an apple after lunch too.
After lunch, the children feel full but not heavy. They learn that a balanced diet keeps them healthy. They decide to make good choices every day.

title: Milk box magic
passage:
Dear all,
Each of us has a box of milk every day at school. We use over 150,000 milk boxes every year! But many of us just throw them away.
Milk boxes have three parts: paper, plastic and metal. Each part can turn into something new, like newspapers, bottles and cans.
It is easy to recycle a milk box in just three steps:
1. Open the milk box and wash it with water.
2. Make it flat.
3. Put it into a recycling box.
Now the milk box moves to a new beginning! Let's start now for a green world!
Students from Class 502

title: The three Rs: reduce, reuse, recycle
passage:
We can follow the three Rs to live a green life.
First, reduce. Don't buy too many things we don't need, and don't take too much food on our plate. Saving energy at home is also a good way: turn off the lights when we leave a room.
Second, reuse. Use both sides of the paper. We can give old books and clothes to others instead of throwing them away. Old T-shirts can become shopping bags.
Third, recycle. Sort the rubbish into different bins. Paper, glass, metal and plastic can be recycled and turn into new things.
Earth Day comes on 22 April every year, but we can be green every day. Small actions add up.

source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上知识清单U2（3R/Earth Day）原创

title: Cutting down plastic at school

Our class wants to cut down plastic use at school. We talk about easy things we can do every day.
We should bring our own lunch boxes instead of plastic boxes. We can also bring our own water bottles and stop using plastic straws. At break time, we pick up rubbish on the playground and sort it into recycling bins.

title: Duoduo's best friends
passage:
For Duoduo, Tutu is his best and only friend. He wants to play with Tutu, but Tutu is playing with two other boys. This makes Duoduo unhappy.
Tutu asks Duoduo to join them, but Duoduo just walks away.
After a week, Duoduo feels sad and misses Tutu. "But Tutu may not miss me because he has new friends," he thinks.
Just then, Tutu sits down next to him. "Hi Duoduo. How are you?" Tutu asks.
"I'm unhappy because I'm not your friend now," answers Duoduo.
"Why do you say that?" says Tutu. "Yes, I have new friends, but you're still my friend. Old friends and new friends are both very nice. Join us and they can be your friends, too."
Now Duoduo has three best friends!

title: Say sorry and talk it out
passage:
Mum: Sally, what's wrong? You look worried.

Mum: Are you still angry?
Sally: No. But what should I do?
Mum: First, go and say sorry to Mia. Friends should be nice to each other.
Sally: OK. Then what?
Mum: Next, have a talk with Mia. Friends should listen to each other. You can find the right plan for the homework.
Sally: Thank you, Mum.
Mum: I'm sure you can be good friends again very soon.

title: What makes a good friend?
passage:
What is a friend? A friend is someone who shares your happiness and stands by you when you are sad.
Tutu and I live in the same street. Every morning we walk to school together. At school, we help each other with homework. When I am sad, Tutu often tells me jokes and makes me laugh.
We have different hobbies. Tutu likes sports, and I like reading. But we still enjoy talking to each other after class. Sometimes friends argue, but that is OK. We should say sorry when we are wrong.
Every year, 30 July is the United Nations International Day of Friendship. On that day, people say thank you to their friends. Good friends make our life warm and colourful.

source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上知识清单U3（友谊日）原创

title: The boy who carved a word on the desk
passage:

title: Julia Hawkins: try new things

Billy: She's so cool! I should try new things, like her.

title: Our New Year plans
passage:
A new year is a good time to make plans. Our class talks about what we are going to try.
Amy is going to read more books. She wants to read twenty books this year. Sam is going to exercise more and run every morning. Lingling is going to learn to play the piano. At first she plays badly and wants to stop, but her mother says, "It's OK to fail. Don't give up."

Making a plan is easy, but keeping it is hard. If we try our best and never give up, we grow better day by day.

title: It's OK to fail
passage:
Everyone wants to be good at something, but nobody is good at it at first. When I started to ride a bike, I fell down many times. I wanted to stop. My father told me, "You may fail, but that's okay. Just start again."
I kept practising every weekend. Slowly, I could balance and then ride around the park. I felt so proud.
Now I understand: trying new things is never a waste. Failure is just a step on the way to success. Don't be afraid. Just start today, and keep going.
passageZh: 人人都想擅长某事，但起初没人天生就会。我学骑车时摔了很多次，想放弃。爸爸说：“你可能失败，但没关系，重新开始就好。”我每个周末坚持练习，慢慢能保持平衡，然后能绕着公园骑，我特别自豪。现在我明白：尝试新事物从不白费，失败只是通往成功的一步。别害怕，今天就开始，坚持下去。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上Fuel up chant U4+知识清单原创

title: Robots in our future life

In the future, robots will be part of our daily life. They will work in factories, hospitals and farms. Some robots will cook, clean and look after old people. Others will help students in the classroom, but students will still read and write by themselves.
People will travel by flying cars, and the cars will take us anywhere in minutes. We will use 3-D printing to make food, clothes and even houses.
Machines will not do everything. Students will still study hard, because thinking and learning are important. The future will be wonderful if we care about nature.

title: Life on the moon
passage:
What will life be like on the moon? Some scientists say people will live in comfortable rooms under glass. Plants will grow inside, and people will grow fresh food there.
Children won't carry heavy bags. They will read on small computers at home or at school. Robots will help with heavy work, and people will have more time for hobbies and friends.
People will put on special shoes to fly from place to place. On weekends, families will look at the Earth in the sky and tell stories.
Living on the moon sounds amazing, but we must study science hard to build that future ourselves.

title: Chinese traditional festivals
passage:
China has many traditional festivals. The Spring Festival is the most important. Before it, people clean their houses and buy delicious food. On New Year's Eve, families have a big dinner, eat dumplings and watch the New Year show. Children wear new clothes and get red packets.
The Mid-Autumn Festival comes in autumn. On that night, the moon is big and round. People sit together, eat mooncakes and watch the full moon.
The Dragon Boat Festival remembers the great poet Qu Yuan. People eat rice dumplings and watch dragon boat races.
At every festival, families get together. Festivals tell us about our culture and history.

title: A frog's life cycle
passage:
A frog's life cycle is a story of growing up too. First, it is an egg in the water. Then it becomes a tadpole with a long tail. It can't walk, but it can swim. Next, the tadpole grows legs. Its tail becomes shorter. Then it becomes a young frog. It can jump and live on land. At last, it is a big frog. It can catch insects for food. Growing up helps the frog live in different places.
A frog lays many eggs in the pond in spring. Each egg hatches into a tadpole that breathes with gills and swims with a long tail. Slowly the tadpole grows back legs and then front legs, while its tail slowly shrinks. When the gills disappear and lungs grow, the young frog climbs onto land. The whole cycle usually takes about two or three months. Watching this change teaches children that every living thing grows step by step, just like we do ourselves.
passageZh:
青蛙的生命周期也是一个成长故事。起初它是水里的一颗卵，然后变成长尾巴的蝌蚪，不会走但会游。接着蝌蚪长出腿，尾巴变短，变成幼蛙，会跳、能在陆地生活。最后变成大青蛙，能捕捉昆虫为食。成长帮助青蛙生活在不同地方。
春天青蛙在池塘里产下许多卵。每颗卵孵化成蝌蚪，用鳃呼吸、用长尾游泳。蝌蚪慢慢长出后腿再长前腿，尾巴逐渐缩短。鳃消失、肺长出后，幼蛙爬上陆地。整个周期通常需要两三个月。观察这一变化教会孩子：每个生命都像我们自己一样一步步成长。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下U1测试卷笔试（提高卷·阅读选择）

title: Tom's growing-up moment
passage:
Last year, Tom joined a swimming club. At first, he couldn't swim at all. He was nervous and often felt tired. His coach and friends helped him a lot. Every week, he practiced for 2 hours. After 3 months, Tom could swim 50 meters. On the club's competition day, he even got the 3rd prize. He felt proud of himself. That was his favorite growing-up moment.
The swimming club met twice a week after school. At first, Tom often touched the wall with his feet instead of his hands, and he breathed at the wrong time. But the coach corrected him patiently, and his club friends cheered him on. Three months of steady practice turned a nervous boy into a confident swimmer. When he stood on the small prize stage, his parents were in the crowd and smiled with pride. Tom now tells his little brother that practice, not talent, helps you grow.
passageZh:
去年汤姆加入游泳俱乐部。起初他根本不会游，紧张又常觉得累。教练和朋友帮了他很多。他每周练习2小时，三个月后能游50米。俱乐部比赛那天他还得了三等奖，为自己骄傲。那是他最爱的成长瞬间。
游泳俱乐部每周放学后活动两次。起初汤姆常碰到脚而不是手，换气时机也不对。但教练耐心纠正，俱乐部朋友为他加油。三个月稳定练习把紧张的男孩变成自信的游泳者。站上小小的领奖台时，父母在人群中骄傲地笑。汤姆现在告诉弟弟：让人成长的是练习，而不是天赋。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下U1测试卷笔试（提高卷·阅读判断改写）

title: Lucy and her cat Mimi
passage:
When I was 7, I wanted a pet cat. But Mom said I was too young to look after a cat. I was sad. Then I tried to show I could be responsible: I cleaned my room every day, and helped feed our neighbor's dog. When I was 9, Mom bought me a cat. I named her Mimi. Now I feed Mimi, clean her bed and play with her every day. I know growing up means learning to take care of others.
Looking after a pet teaches children real responsibility. After getting Mimi, I made a simple chart on the wall: feed her in the morning, clean the litter box in the evening, and play for ten minutes every day. When Mimi was sick once, I sat by her bed and gave her medicine carefully. The family doctor said the cat grew healthy again because of my care. I now understand that loving an animal means showing up every single day, not just on the happy days.
passageZh:
我7岁时想要一只宠物猫，妈妈说我太小不会照顾，我很难过。于是我努力表现出责任感：每天打扫房间，帮着喂邻居的狗。9岁时妈妈给我买了只猫，取名咪咪。现在我每天喂咪咪、清理它的窝、陪它玩。我懂得成长意味着学会照顾别人。
照顾宠物教会孩子真正的责任。得到咪咪后，我在墙上做了简单表格：早上喂食、晚上清理猫窝、每天陪玩十分钟。有次咪咪生病，我守在它床边认真喂药。家庭医生说，正是我的照料让猫恢复健康。我现在懂得，爱一只动物意味着每天都在，而不只是在开心的日子。

title: An unforgettable survival camp
passage: Last month, I joined a survival camp. On the first day, I felt worried because I didn't know anyone. The training was challenging—we learned to start a fire and find clean water. But my teammates helped me a lot. On the fourth day, we cooked hot pot together. I made vegetable dumplings, and everyone said they were delicious! On the fifth day, we watched a video about plant growth: a seed sprouts, grows leaves, and finally becomes a big tree. After the camp, I felt confident. It was an unforgettable growing-up moment.

title: Lily grows up at camp
passage:
Hello! I'm Lily. Last year, I was 7. I was short and shy. I couldn't ride a bike or swim. I wanted to be brave, so I joined a summer camp. At the camp, I practiced riding a bike every morning. I also learnt to swim. At first, I was nervous. But my friends helped me. By the end of the camp, I could ride a bike and swim well. I was very proud. Now I'm 8. I'm tall and confident. Growing up is wonderful!
After the camp, I wrote about my summer in my diary. I drew a small bike beside the words I can ride, and a little wave beside the words I can swim. My teacher read the diary in class and praised my growth. I realised that growing up is not about being tall alone; it is about trying, failing, getting up again and finally believing in myself. I look forward to next year's camp and the new things I will learn there.
passageZh:
你好，我是莉莉。去年我7岁，又矮又害羞，不会骑车也不会游泳。我想变勇敢，就参加了夏令营。在营里我每天早上练骑车，还学了游泳。起初紧张，但朋友帮我。到营结束时，我骑车和游泳都很好，非常自豪。现在我8岁，又高又自信。成长真美好！
营后我把夏天写进日记，在“我会骑车”旁边画了辆小自行车，在“我会游泳”旁边画了朵小浪花。老师在班上读了我的日记，表扬我的成长。我意识到，成长不只是长高，而是尝试、失败、重新站起，最终相信自己。我期待明年的营地和那里要学的新事物。

unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference
title: What volunteers do
passage:
Volunteers help people in need. They go to care homes to visit the old, go to children's homes to play with kids, and clean up parks to make the city beautiful. Volunteers don't get money, but they feel happy because they can help others. Many people join volunteer activities to learn to care for others.
Volunteers come from every age group: students, office workers, retirees and even families with children. They give their free time and do not ask for pay. At weekends, you can see volunteers cleaning the streets, helping at a book fair, or feeding stray animals. Being a volunteer teaches us kindness, patience and teamwork. When everyone shares a little love, our neighbourhood becomes a warmer and better place for all.
passageZh:
志愿者帮助有需要的人。他们去敬老院看望老人，去儿童之家陪孩子玩，打扫公园让城市变美。志愿者不拿报酬，但因为能帮助别人而快乐。许多人参加志愿活动，学习关心他人。
志愿者来自各个年龄层：学生、上班族、退休老人，甚至带孩子的家庭。他们献出空闲时间，不求报酬。周末你能看到志愿者打扫街道、在书展帮忙、或喂流浪动物。做志愿教会我们善良、耐心和团队合作。当每个人都献出一点爱，社区就会成为更温暖、更美好的地方。

unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference
title: A kind act at the bus stop
passage:
One afternoon, Tom saw an old man carrying heavy bags at the bus stop. The old man could not walk easily. Tom ran over and helped the old man carry his bags to the bus. The old man thanked Tom many times. Tom felt proud of himself and knew that small acts of kindness can help others a lot.
After helping the old man onto the bus, Tom watched him sit down comfortably. The old man smiled and patted Tom's shoulder. On his way home, Tom thought about his own grandfather, who lived alone in another city. He decided to visit his grandfather more often and carry his shopping bags whenever possible. A small act, Tom realised, does not need money, just a kind heart and two willing hands.
passageZh:
一天下午，汤姆在公交站看见一位老人拎着沉重的袋子，走路很吃力。汤姆跑过去帮老人把袋子拎到公交车上。老人多次感谢汤姆。汤姆为自己骄傲，也懂得小小的善举能帮别人很多。
帮老人上了公交车后，汤姆看着他安稳坐下。老人笑着拍拍汤姆的肩膀。回家路上，汤姆想起独自住在另一座城市的爷爷，决定更常去看爷爷，能帮拎购物袋时就帮一把。汤姆意识到，小小的善举不需要花钱，只需要一颗善心和一双愿意出力的手。

unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference
title: A visit to the care home
passage:
Last weekend, we went to the care home. We read books to the old people and helped them clean their rooms. The old people were very happy, and we felt warm, and the visit felt meaningful. We took photos and will make a photo album for them. We will go there again next month.
The care home is a clean and quiet place where old people live who have no family to look after them. On that Saturday, the old grandparents sat in the sun and listened to our reading. Some of them held our hands and told us stories about their own youth. When it was time to leave, they walked us to the door and said thank you again and again. We all felt that a simple visit can warm an old person's whole day.

敬老院是一个干净安静的地方，住着没有家人照顾的老人。那个周六，老人们坐在阳光下听我们读书，有的握着我们的手讲他们年轻时的故事。临走时他们送我们到门口，一遍遍说谢谢。我们都感到，一次简单的探望能温暖老人一整天。

unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference
title: Learn from Lei Feng
passage:
Lei Feng was a kind man. He always helped people. He was like a bright star. He taught us to help others. Many people learned from him. We should do volunteer work too. We can help at a care home or clean up a park. Everyone can make a difference.
Lei Feng was a soldier in the People's Liberation Army in the 1960s. He did many small good things every day: he helped his comrades clean their rooms, gave his own money to people in trouble, and always put others first. He died very young, but his story still lives on. Every year on 5 March, people in China learn from Lei Feng and do volunteer work to help those around them. His example tells us that a warm heart can make a big difference.
passageZh:
雷锋是个善良的人，总是帮助别人，像一颗明亮的星。他教我们帮助他人，很多人向他学习。我们也应做志愿工作，可以去敬老院帮忙或打扫公园。每个人都能带来改变。
雷锋是20世纪60年代人民解放军的一名战士。他每天做许多小小的好事：帮战友打扫房间、把自己的钱给有困难的人，总是先人后己。他很年轻就去世了，但他的故事流传至今。每年3月5日，中国人向雷锋学习，做志愿工作帮助身边的人。他的榜样告诉我们，一颗温暖的心能带来很大改变。

unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference
title: Sam at the children's home
passage:
Last month, I joined a volunteer activity with my classmates. We went to the children's home. We read books to the kids and played games with them. The kids were very happy, and we felt warm. We also gave them some books and toys. I learned that helping others can make both others and ourselves happy.
The children's home looks after boys and girls who have no parents nearby. Our activity lasted the whole afternoon. Besides reading and games, we taught the children some simple English songs and drew pictures together. Before leaving, each child received a warm hug. My classmate Tom said he wanted to come back every month. Helping children in need makes us remember that kindness never goes to waste.
passageZh:
上个月我和同学参加志愿活动，去了儿童之家。给孩子们读书、陪他们玩游戏，孩子们很开心，我们很温暖。我们还送了一些书和玩具。我懂得帮助别人能让别人和自己都快乐。
儿童之家照看身边没有父母的男孩女孩。我们的活动持续了整个下午。除了读书和游戏，我们还教孩子们几首简单的英文歌，一起画画。临走前每个孩子都得到一个温暖的拥抱。同学汤姆说他想每月都来。帮助有需要的孩子让我们记住：善意从不白费。
